FISHING LICENCE · BRAZIL

Brazil fishing licence

Recreational anglers generally need a federal licence, including foreign visitors. Some states also require a local licence, and protected waters can have extra restrictions.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Brazilian and foreign recreational anglers who do not qualify for an exemption.

Who doesn’t

  • The federal guide exempts anglers who use only a handline or simple pole for non-commercial fishing.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Shore licenceany1 yearBRL 20
Boat licence, also covers shore fishingany1 yearBRL 60

Extra stamps and permits

  • State fishing licence
    Some states require a supplementary licence.

Saltwater

The federal licence applies nationally, subject to state, municipal and protected-area rules.

Rules visitors should know

  • Do not sell a recreational catch.
  • Complete and submit the application; payment alone does not complete it.

How to buy

Apply through gov.br. The 2026 ministry guide allows a Brazilian citizen to apply for a foreign visitor without a CPF, using passport details.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Brazil?

Recreational anglers generally need a federal licence, including foreign visitors. Some states also require a local licence, and protected waters can have extra restrictions.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Brazil?

Shore licence: BRL 20; Boat licence, also covers shore fishing: BRL 60 (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Brazil?

Apply through gov.br. The 2026 ministry guide allows a Brazilian citizen to apply for a foreign visitor without a CPF, using passport details.
